Genuine NISSAN Motor Oil 0W-20 SP or equivalent synthetic 0W-20 SP GF-6A. API certification / ILSAC certification required.

oil_life_monitor: The vehicle is equipped with an oil control system that calculates engine oil and filter change interval based on driving conditions. Driving in severe conditions will shorten the interval. When the oil replacement indicator appears in the vehicle information display, the engine oil and filter need to be replaced. After replacing the engine oil, reset the display.
extraction_caveats:
1. Tire rotation: The manual explicitly states tires CANNOT be rotated on this vehicle because front and rear tires are different sizes and/or wheel rim offsets — no rotation interval recorded.
2. Intercooler coolant is described as 'maintenance-free' in the schedule section; no replacement interval is published.
3. Engine drive belts are marked with '*' (recommended, not warranty-required) and first appear at 60,000 miles/72 months; the interval repeats every 10,000 miles/12 months thereafter (60k, 70k, 80k, 90k, 100k, 110k, 120k confirmed in schedule).
4. Intelligent Key battery: the schedule shows an 'inspect' at 15,000 miles/18 months and 'replace' every 30,000 miles/36 months (30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k confirmed).
5. In-cabin microfilter replaces every 15,000 miles/18 months (15k, 30k, 45k, 60k, 75k, 90k, 105k, 120k confirmed).
6. Air cleaner filter replaces every 30,000 miles/36 months (30k, 60k, 90k, 120k confirmed).
7. Differential gear oil replacement (standard) is every 20,000 miles/24 months but only 'with limited slip differential' per footnotes at 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k, 120k.
8. Brake fluid standard replacement interval is every 20,000 miles/24 months based on the schedule (20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 100k, 120k); severe is every 10,000 miles/12 months.
9. Engine coolant first replacement is at 105,000 miles OR 84 months (7 years); subsequent replacements every 75,000 miles or 60 months per footnote on page 380. Engine coolant is marked '*' (recommended, not warranty-required).
10. Automatic transmission fluid capacity is not listed (shown as '—' in the table on page 384); manual transmission gear oil and differential gear oil capacities are also listed as '—'.
11. Fuel tank vapor vent system and fuel lines/connections are marked '*' (recommended, not warranty-required).
12. Engine valve clearance is marked '*' and is inspect-only if valve noise increases — no fixed interval published; omitted from schedule.
13. The schedule covers up to 120,000 miles/144 months; after that, continue at the same intervals.
14. NISMO model intercooler coolant capacity (3-5/8 qt) and engine coolant capacity (11 qt) differ from standard AT/MT models.
15. Spark plugs appear only once at 105,000 miles/126 months in the schedule; no repeat interval is shown within the 120,000-mile range.
16. Propeller shaft is listed under standard maintenance at 10,000 miles/12 months (as an 'Essential' item at 10k), not just severe.
